statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low; weekend energy risk keeps Stress extreme.
recommendation: Descriptive state: low Tail, extreme Stress, with NQ closed and no live price path.
headline: Closed NQ keeps Tail low; energy risk keeps Stress extreme
body: NQ is closed, so persistent one-way structure cannot be observed. Friday mixed semiconductor strength with negative breadth, while yields above 5% and crude above $100 kept Stress elevated. Saudi pipeline disruption adds reopening-gap uncertainty, not live Tail evidence.
